sources.title: Order and Disorder in Colonial South India
sources.note: Peer-reviewed account of wartime revenue assignment, Company power, and political disorder in the Carnatic.

sources.title: Nightingale, A Successor to the Moguls
sources.note: Scholarly study of the Nawab, Company alliance, war, administration, and changing authority through 1785.

sources.title: Treaty with Azeem-ool-Dowlah, 1801
sources.note: Primary treaty text transferring exclusive civil and military administration while preserving a titled court.

sources.title: House of Commons debate on the debts of the Nabobs of Arcot
sources.note: Primary parliamentary record of the 1787 arrangements, subsidy, wartime revenues, and disputed debts.

sources.title: Menon, The Carnatic Debts and the Agrarian Crisis
sources.note: Research synthesis of debt, revenue assignments, peasant burdens, tax farming, wartime shortage, and the 1801 transfer.

sources.title: British Library catalogue: Nawab of Arcot correspondence
sources.note: Archive catalogue for Nawab, Company, revenue, diplomacy, and court correspondence surviving from the period.

sources.title: British Library catalogue: Umdat ul-Umara objections
sources.note: Primary archival file cataloguing Umdat ul-Umara objections and Company proceedings around contested authority.

sources.title: Morgan Library: letter to Umdat ul-Umara
sources.note: Museum catalogue for a 1796 letter addressed to Umdat ul-Umara and its documentary context.

sources.title: District Census Handbook, North Arcot
sources.note: Government historical summary of war ending, revenue management, 1801 transfer, local resistance, and Vellore 1806.

sources.title: District Census Handbook, Nellore
sources.note: Government historical summary of the 1792 settlement, debt pressure, succession dispute, and 1801 administration.

sources.title: District Census Handbook, Kancheepuram
sources.note: Government district history of Company revenue management, cession, and subsequent administrative incorporation.

sources.title: Jeyaraj, A Technical Study on the Coins of Arcot Nawabs
sources.note: Government Museum study of rulers, mints, scripts, motifs, metallurgy, coin manufacture, palace, and Madrasa-i-Azam.

sources.title: Government Museum Chennai departmental publications
sources.note: Official institutional context for the museum collection and its Arcot coin research publication.

sources.title: Arcot Municipality: places of interest
sources.note: Official municipal account identifying Arcot as an eighteenth-century Nawab headquarters and historic town.

sources.title: Tamil Nadu Archives and Historical Research
sources.note: Official archive description for permanent government records, manuscripts, proceedings, and research access.

sources.title: Wellcome Collection: Buchanan, A Journey from Madras
sources.note: Authoritative catalogue and public-domain access record for Buchanan's 1800 to 1801 survey journey.

sources.title: Rare Book Society of India: Buchanan volume one and extract
sources.note: Digitized primary extract describing the 1800 route, heat, rice fields, tanks, roads, mud houses, tiles, and palmyra roofs.

sources.title: Heidelberg University digitization of Buchanan volume one
sources.note: University digitization of the primary survey covering Madras, Conjeveram, Arcot, Vellore, agriculture, arts, and commerce.

sources.title: Variolation, Vaccination and Popular Resistance in Early Colonial South India
sources.note: Peer-reviewed study of smallpox, 1787 inoculation, multilingual campaigns, vaccination after 1802, access, and resistance.

sources.title: Dharampal, The Beautiful Tree: Madras education survey
sources.note: Published 1822 to 1825 survey evidence for North Arcot schools, languages, pupils, timing, caste, gender, and home tuition.

sources.title: Mintage World: coinage of Umdat ul-Umara
sources.note: Specialist object record for an Arcot silver rupee, ruler, mint, issuer, denomination, and Persian legends.

sources.title: Oriental Numismatic Society Journal 247: Shah Alam legend catalogue
sources.note: Peer-reviewed numismatic catalogue giving transliteration and translation for the standardized Shah Alam coin formula.

sources.title: Oswal Auction 90 catalogue: Umdat ul-Umara pagoda
sources.note: Specialist catalogue record for a period Umdat ul-Umara gold pagoda with three deities and Persian ayn.

sources.title: Sarmaya Arts Foundation, Odyssey of the Rupee
sources.note: Museum brochure documenting successful Arcot-style rupees and their role in south Indian trade.

sources.title: Victoria and Albert Museum: Splendours of India royal courts
sources.note: Museum context for a portrait of Muhammad Ali Khan and the material culture of Indian courts.

sources.title: Edinburgh Research Archive: The Vellore Mutiny of 1806
sources.note: University research on Vellore, military households, Company rule, uniforms, religion, rumor, and the 1806 uprising.

sources.title: House of Commons debate on Azeem Jah and the Nawab of the Carnatic
sources.note: Primary retrospective debate on the 1801 settlement, court provision, succession, family, and later title.

sources.title: Library of Congress: eighteenth-century North Arcot Persian manuscript
sources.note: Library manuscript record illustrating surviving Persian textual culture and uncertain authorship from North Arcot.
